mechanism_findings.path_invariance: All 120 paired development paths exactly matched reward, executed-action, and latent-policy trace hashes at gauge strengths zero and one. All three cells passed the explicit asynchronous-transition, reconstruction-RMS, and component-projection gates.
mechanism_findings.lower_frequency: The audit-optimal gauge reduced realized lower-LPF32 power by 66.5 percent in Hopper and 72.6 percent in Walker2d, but increased it by 48.3 percent in HalfCheetah.
mechanism_findings.upper_frequency: No environment achieved the frozen ten-percent upper-HPF8 reduction. Realized upper-HF power increased by factors of 11.31 in HalfCheetah, 1.95 in Hopper, and 8.33 in Walker2d relative to the function-preserving control.
mechanism_findings.joint_merit: Normalized joint merit improved by 56.5 percent in Hopper and 72.5 percent in Walker2d but worsened by 256.4 percent in HalfCheetah. The registered all-environment expansion gate therefore failed.
mechanism_findings.decision: Do not expand v17.3 to leakage-active multiseed training. The next mechanism must align the online optimization boundary with realized audit windows and constrain upper-coordinate boundary increments directly; a persistence forecast optimized only within the current macro interval is not sufficient.
